continuity: Prince Shangshan remains in the imperial capital under the care of palace attendants led by So Gyo; Taekyung gave him the Myriad-Poison Ring for protection against poisoning.
Taekyung believes the Emperor and Dark Heaven are connected, but their relationship remains unconfirmed.

Qianqing Palace’s defenses include mechanisms and formations, at least three Supreme Peak masters, and more than a hundred elite assassins; So Gyo escorts Taekyung out and can summon palace assassins.
Taekyung hears Aehyang’s voice in a restricted part of Qianqing Palace and recognizes her as the concubine the City Lord of Sichuan Province lost to the Emperor; her situation there is unknown.
plot: After Prince Shangshan is escorted away, So Gyo leads Jin Taekyung through Qianqing Palace’s guarded, maze-like corridors. Taekyung learns the palace uses mechanisms and formations, then hears a woman’s angry voice from a restricted passage and recognizes it as Aehyang, the concubine the City Lord of Sichuan Province lost to the Emperor. When Taekyung tries to investigate, So Gyo and palace assassins stop him; he surrenders and continues toward the exit.
translation_decisions: Retain “Third Shadow,” “First Shadow,” “No Shadow,” and “Marquis Within the Passes.”

active_continuity: Prince Shangshan remains in the imperial capital under the care of palace attendants led by So Gyo; Taekyung gave him the Myriad-Poison Ring for protection against poisoning.
The palace attendants assigned to Shangshan are First Rate martial artists who carry flexible swords.
The Emperor has a concealed Supreme Peak assassin, No Shadow.
Taekyung suspects the Emperor is connected to Dark Heaven, but this is unconfirmed.

Taekyung heard Aehyang’s voice in a restricted part of Qianqing Palace and recognized her as the concubine the City Lord of Sichuan Province lost to the Emperor.
open_questions: What does the Emperor intend for Shangshan, and what are the palace attendants’ true orders?
What is Aehyang’s situation in the restricted part of Qianqing Palace?
What is the nature of the Emperor’s connection to Dark Heaven?
